hook: A spear fisherman was caught in pounding surf.
narration: This spear fisherman was in trouble off Dog Island, with surf pounding the rocks.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk crew arrived overhead.
They sent their rescue swimmer down the cable, into the whitewater.
On a direct deployment the swimmer stays hooked to the cable, [short pause] so the hoist can pull him clear.
He got hold of the fisherman by the rocks.
outcome: The crew hoisted them both out of the surf and flew the fisherman safely to St. Thomas.
title: Spear fisherman hoisted out of the surf
description:
A Coast Guard MH-60T Jayhawk aircrew rescued a spear fisherman in distress just off Dog Island, U.S. Virgin Islands, on Sept. 4, 2022, and brought him to St. Thomas.
